_about: Hand verdicts on first drafts the checker flagged, by run and request id: 'real' or 'false_alarm'. Each was checked against the plan_route result stored in that run's results file. Every reply in v1 to v4 was also read by hand to look for errors the checker missed; those are listed as 'missed'.

loop-05.note: Chemin Senneville and Boulevard Gouin Ouest are both highlights; the checker joined the names across 'and'.

loop-06.note: Avenue du Parc-La Fontaine and Piste cyclable du Canal de l'Aqueduc are both highlights; joined across 'and the'.

climb-03.note: Rue Willibrord and Piste Cyclable du Canal de Lachine are both highlights; joined across 'and the'.

stop-03.note: Says the loop 'follows the water'; the only highlight is Rue Sainte-Catherine Ouest, through green space. Not flagged by the v2 checker, which had no scenery-claim rule; the rule was added after this.

fr-01.note: "Notez" (French 'Note') at the start of a sentence read as a name.

loop-04.note: Says 'this route is paved' (the app has no surface data) and 'the closest loop I could find' although distance_on_target is true. Neither was checked in v3; both rules were added after this.
